title: Phase-Consistent Magnetic Spectral Learning for Multi-View Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2602.18728v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unsupervised multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to partition data into meaningful groups by leveraging complementary information from multiple views without labels, yet a central challenge is to obtain a reliable shared structural signal to guide representation learning and cross-view alignment under view discrepancy and noise. Existing approaches often rely on magnitude-only affinities or early pseudo targets, which can be unstable when different views induce relations with comparable strengths but contradictory directional tendencies, thereby distorting the global spectral geometry and degrading clustering. In this paper, we propose Phase-Consistent Magnetic Spectral Learning for MVC: we derive a confidence-directed cross-view flow from anchor assignments, encode it as a phase term, and combine it with a nonnegative magnitude backbone to form a complex-valued magnetic affinity, extract a stable shared spectral signal via a Hermitian

translated_title: 相位一致的磁谱学习用于多视图聚类
translated_abstract: 无监督多视图聚类（MVC）旨在通过利用多个视图的互补信息而无标签地将数据划分为有意义的组，但一个核心挑战是在视图差异和噪声下获得可靠的共享结构信号，以指导表示学习和跨视图对齐。现有方法通常依赖仅幅度的亲和度或早期伪目标，当不同视图产生强度相当但方向趋势矛盾的关联时，这些方法可能不稳定，从而扭曲全局谱几何并降低聚类性能。本文中，我们提出相位一致的磁谱学习用于MVC：我们从锚点分配中推导出置信度引导的跨视图流，将其编码为相位项，并与非负幅度主干结合形成复值磁亲和度，通过厄米特矩阵提取稳定的共享谱信号。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于相位一致性的磁谱学习方法，通过将跨视图置信流编码为相位项并与幅度结合，生成复值亲和度以稳定提取共享谱信号，从而解决多视图聚类中视图矛盾导致的谱几何失真问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a phase-consistent magnetic spectral learning method that encodes cross-view confidence flow as a phase term combined with magnitude to form complex-valued affinity, extracting stable shared spectral signals to address spectral geometry distortion in multi-view clustering.
